verdict.rationale: BugSnag's official bugsnag-js SDK automatically detects errors in the browser (web frontend), Node.js with Express/Restify/Koa plugins (backend), and React Native (mobile). The docs claim error reporting libraries for over 50 platforms, and a community user confirms the iOS SDK installs in minutes and reports fatal errors automatically. Missing for 10: specific evidence of automatic uncaught-error capture for non-JavaScript backends and native Android, beyond the general 50+ platforms claim.
